comments.text: 💵 A “cheap country” doesn’t automatically mean an easy life for locals. Ten dollars can be casual spending for a tourist but a carefully considered expense for someone earning a local wage.

comments.author: @moreto62
comments.text: “$10 a day and live like a king” is pure clickbait. You might survive on $10/day if you already have housing and live very frugally, but that’s not “living like a king.” Rent, utilities, healthcare, and everyday expenses quickly push the real cost much higher. Uzbekistan is affordable, but let’s be honest instead of misleading people for views.😂😂😂😂😂😂

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: Fair point 😂 The “$10 a day” line definitely sounds exaggerated if it’s taken as the full cost of actually living there. The more interesting reality is that Uzbekistan can feel very affordable to someone earning in dollars, while rent, utilities, healthcare, and everyday expenses look completely different on a local salary. Have you lived in Uzbekistan, or are you speaking from travel experience there?
